 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Washington Wizards (4-5, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, third in the Western Conference)
 Oklahoma City; Saturday, 8 p.m. EST
 LINE: Thunder -11.5; over/under is 220.5
 BOTTOM LINE: Oklahoma City will try to keep its four-game home win streak intact when the Thunder play Washington.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Oklahoma City went 64-18 overall a season ago while going 34-8 at home. The Thunder averaged 119.0 points per game last season, 49.2 in the paint, 22.0 off of turnovers and 14.0 on fast breaks.
 Washington went 17-65 overall with a 6-35 record on the road a season ago. The Wizards gave up 124.9 points per game while committing 21.3 fouls last season.
 INJURIES: Thunder: Cason Wallace: out (shoulder), Nikola Topic: out (back), Thomas Sorber: out (knee), Chet Holmgren: out (knee), Jaylin Williams: out (back), Jalen Williams: out (ankle).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Wizards: Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl), Anthony Davis: day to day (ankle), Justin Champagnie: out (foot), Reece Beekman: out (shoulder).
